name: Gionni Lewis
strengths: Lewis shows real play speed as #1 outside — vertical gear that stacks off coverage and runs past DBs on go/fade balls (freshman + sophomore tape).
Lewis turns short throws into chunk YAC with sudden burst after the catch — screen cuts into space and in-breakers taken the distance.
Lewis flashes house-call return speed as a punt returner (plant-and-go) plus clean over-the-shoulder tracking and a one-hand grab in stride.
weaknesses: Lewis is still a lean 6-0 / 175 freshman mold — needs functional mass and a more varied release package vs physical press before every-down SEC snaps.
comparison: Lewis comps to Jordan Addison — listed 6-0 / 175 vs Addison's ~5-11 / 175 sudden WR mold (height within ~1", same lean skill frame); then matching vertical stack, tracking hands, and twitchy YAC from Lewis's freshman + sophomore tape (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Lewis projects as a Year-1 scout-team / developmental perimeter WR, Year 2–3 compete for rotational snaps, with every-down Z/slot WR upside if the 6-0 / 175 frame fills and the release package holds vs press.
schemeFit: Lewis fits a multiple WR package that can park a lean separator outside as Z or flexed in the slot while he adds mass — vertical threat + YAC after the catch.
